*⚠️ Trezor shipping provider breach exposes personal data of nearly 14,000 customers*

( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-08-13-trezor-shipping-provider-breach-exposes-personal-data-nearly-14000-customers-411702?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

A breach at *Trezor's* shipping provider *ShipMonk* exposed the personal data of nearly 14,000 customers, including names, phone numbers, and home addresses.

* ShipMonk told the hardware wallet maker on Monday that an unauthorized party had accessed systems holding customer order data, affecting people across the U.S., UK, Sweden, Colombia, Brazil, Italy, and Portugal.
* Trezor said the data breach does not affect its internal systems and that its hardware wallet devices remain secure.

🧠 Crypto News Brief: Wall Street bought its way deeper into crypto while prices barely moved. Goldman and Fidelity chased yield, regulators chased advertisers, and an in-line CPI print left Bitcoin pinned below $64,000. 🏦 Goldman Sachs Buys Its Way Into Bitcoin ETFs in $2.25B NEOS Deal Goldman Sachs agreed to acquire NEOS Investments for up to $2.25 billion in cash and equity, absorbing 19 options-income ETFs with more than $30 billion in assets — including BTCI, a roughly $1 billion Bitcoin covered-call fund, plus Boosted Bitcoin (XBCI) and Ethereum High Income (NEHI). The purchase lands Goldman an established crypto income business instead of the one it filed to build in April, and lifts its combined ETF platform above $130 billion. Closing is expected in Q1 2027, pending regulatory approval. Read full story ⚡ Fidelity Files to Stake Up to 100% of Its $898M Ether ETF Fidelity submitted an amended registration statement to the SEC to let the Fidelity Ethereum Fund (FETH) stake as much as 100% of its ether and pay holders quarterly cash distributions. The fund would keep 85% of gross staking rewards, with 15% going to the sponsor, custodians and node operators — Blockdaemon, Figment and Galaxy named as validators. It follows Grayscale and BlackRock into yield-bearing ETH products, and cannot begin until the filing is declared effective. More details 📉 In-Line CPI Buys the Fed Time, Leaves Bitcoin Below $64,000 July headline inflation cooled to 3.4% year-over-year and core to 2.5%, both exactly matching consensus. Bitcoin briefly popped toward $64,500 before sliding back under $64,000, unable to escape the range it has held for weeks. September rate-hike odds slipped to roughly 44% on CME FedWatch, keeping the next Fed decision a coin flip after last week's payrolls shock, while futures open interest sat near a three-year low. Read more ⚖️ NYC Council Opens Probe Into Kalshi, Polymarket, Coinbase and Gemini Titan Council Speaker Julie Menin launched a legislative inquiry into the four prediction-market platforms, sending letters demanding New York user numbers, revenue and advertising practices within 14 days. The focus is potentially false, deceptive or abusive marketing, with specific concern about ads reaching people under 21 and undisclosed influencer promotions.
